narrative.overview: The system behaves like a dark exhibition space in which one business-specific material world is progressively revealed. Editorial HTML remains readable and controlled while a persistent cinematic plate, foreground crop, WebGL atmosphere, and authored camera path create depth behind it. The three routes share one motion grammar but never one costume. This is a persuasive experience surface, not an application dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed full-viewport cinematic stage behind scrolling editorial chapters.
Dark opening states that withhold the completed transformation.
Brand-specific accent pairs, materials, light, and camera choreography.
Square, border-led components with no ornamental pill language.
Reduced-motion and static fallback modes that resolve to the final legible composition.

rules.name: The Narrow Signal Rule
rules.body: A route uses only its assigned accent pair; never mix accent palettes across businesses.

rules.name: The One Giant Word Rule
rules.body: Each route gets one oversized action word per hero; do not stack multiple display gimmicks in the same frame.

rules.name: The World Before Chrome Rule
rules.body: Interface styling must remain subordinate to the material transformation and cannot become a floating-card layer over the scene.

dos: Do preserve the shared four-shot scroll grammar while giving each business its own materials, lighting, and camera framing.
Do use verified official brand art exactly as sourced and keep provenance notes with the build.
Do make the opening, midpoint, and final frames materially different states of one transformation.
Do resolve reduced-motion and WebGL-fallback users to a complete, legible final composition.
Do keep touch targets at least 46px high and preserve visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't copy Kage code, artwork, Japanese motifs, or decorative costume.
Don't invent a logo when authentic brand artwork cannot be verified.
Don't reveal the finished room, ring, or pool system in full at the opening frame.
Don't introduce rounded cards, dashboard chrome, stock gradients, or interchangeable route styling.
Don't let WebGL become required for understanding the brand, copy, source boundary, or action.
